topic_title: Traffic Laws as the Foundation for Decisions
prompt: Under Texas Implied Consent law, what legal covenant is established when a motorist operates a motor vehicle upon Texas public roadways?

options.text: The driver consents to warrantless vehicle searches during standard traffic stops
The driver agrees to forfeit their right to contest any moving violation citation
The driver agrees to chemical breath or blood testing if arrested for suspected DWI
The driver waives all administrative hearings regarding license points suspensions
